// CASE prio_weak_self expect=pass
final class A {
  func run(_ items: [Int]) {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(
        Task(priority: .utility) { [weak self] in
          await self?.work(item)
        })
    }
  }
}

// CASE prio_mainactor expect=pass
func f2(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(priority: .userInitiated) { @MainActor in
        await ui.update(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE prio_mainactor_weak expect=pass
final class B {
  func run(_ items: [Int]) {
    for item in items {
      Task(priority: .utility) { @MainActor [weak self] in
        guard let self else { return }
        await self.work(item)
      }
    }
  }
}

// CASE generic_task expect=pass
func f4(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task<Void, Never>(priority: .utility) {
        await work(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE operation_label expect=pass
func f5(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(
        priority: .utility,
        operation: {
          await work(item)
        }))
  }
}

// CASE detached_capture expect=pass
func f6(_ items: [Int], store: Store) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task.detached(priority: .background) { [store] in
        await store.save(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE dict_assign expect=pass
final class C {
  var running: [Int: Task<Void, Never>] = [:]
  func run(_ items: [Int]) {
    for item in items {
      running[item] = Task(priority: .low) {
        await work(item)
      }
    }
  }
}

// CASE let_then_append expect=pass
func f8(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task(priority: .utility) {
      await work(item)
    }
    tasks.append(task)
  }
}

// CASE group_add_priority expect=pass
func f9(_ items: [Int]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask(priority: .utility) {
        await work(item)
      }
    }
  }
}

// CASE group_add_plain_control expect=pass
func f9b(_ items: [Int]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask {
        await work(item)
      }
    }
  }
}

// CASE group_add_unless_cancelled_priority expect=pass
func f10(_ items: [Int]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      _ = group.addTaskUnlessCancelled(priority: .utility) {
        await work(item)
      }
    }
  }
}

// CASE throwing_group_add_priority expect=pass
func f11(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask(priority: .background) {
        try await save(item)
      }
    }
    try await group.waitForAll()
  }
}

// CASE task_name expect=pass
func f12(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(name: "item-\(item)", priority: .utility) {
        await work(item)
      })
  }
}

// CASE task_try_body expect=pass
func f13(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(
      Task(priority: .utility) {
        do {
          try await save(item)
        } catch {
          await report(error)
        }
      })
  }
}
